page_title: ROM 1-1 ATA | AS Roma v Atalanta 07/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jose Mourinho, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+3' The attendance is 60022.

90+1' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' What was Emil Holm (Atalanta) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
88' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
86' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Isak Hien (Atalanta) replaces Giorgio Scalvini.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is coming onto the pitch as Paulo Dybala cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atalanta was in an offside position.
82' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
80' Leonardo Spinazzola picks out Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
79' It's time for a substitution. Jose Luis Palomino (Atalanta) comes on in place of Sead Kolasinac.
78' The game is interrupted now, Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
75' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
75' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Gianluca Aureliano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' Substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini makes way for Leandro Paredes (AS Roma).
70' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner kick, but Rui Patricio reads it well and stops the effort.
70' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Atalanta win a corner.

69' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.
67' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
66' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Zeki Celik (AS Roma) brought his opponent down. Atalanta earn a free kick.
65' Jose Mourinho prepares a substitution. Rick Karsdorp is replaced by Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
65' Substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) on for Nicola Zalewski.
65' Here comes a substitution. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Ederson.
64' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Matteo Ruggeri and he is replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
63' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Aureliano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

62' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Marco Carnesecchi guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
61' Gianluca Scamacca plays the ball through an opponents legs to Ederson (Atalanta), who shoots from the edge of the box. The keeper scrambles across his line but the shot rises just over the bar.
58' Goal disallowed! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) scores but Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies well wide of the right post.
56' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

56' Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the top left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a magnificent save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
55' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
54' The free kick is taken by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), but ball is cleared.
52' A snap shot by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
52' The ball rebounds to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
51' Atalanta try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
51' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
47' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) comes off for Gianluca Scamacca.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Mourinho decided to make a change. Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is replaced by Dean Huijsen.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' Referee Gianluca Aureliano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jose Mourinho, then shows him a yellow.
45+6' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45+5' Emil Holm (Atalanta) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
45+4' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
44' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Gianluca Aureliano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Ederson (Atalanta) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
39' 1 - 1 Goal! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Marco Carnesecchi.
39' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
38' Gianluca Aureliano shows a yellow card to Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
37' The AS Roma players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
37' There's a break in play and referee Gianluca Aureliano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by AS Roma using VAR. This could be interesting!
36' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' PENALTY APPEAL after Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

36' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.

35' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Marco Carnesecchi anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
34' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
33' 4:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
30' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
29' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
28' Ederson (Atalanta) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
27' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta get a free kick.
25' Lorenzo Pellegrini floats over the corner and Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
25' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
24' The ball is cleared after Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
24' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Rui Patricio (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.
24' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.

22' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
22' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

21' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Marco Carnesecchi is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
18' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
16' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marten de Roon (Atalanta) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atalanta.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
14' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
13' Emil Holm (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Rasmus Kristensen, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Aleksey Miranchuk picks out Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the roof of the net with a header from close range. 0:1.
6' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends a long cross over to Rick Karsdorp, but Marco Carnesecchi comes forward to gather the ball.
5' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle after Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano is the one to supervise the game today.
